extracted.name: Italian Horn Cookies
extracted.description: Great recipe for Italian Horn Cookies.
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, cut butter into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in ice cream.
Divide into four portions. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.
On a lightly-floured surface, roll each portion to 1/8 inch thickness. With a fluted pastry-cutter, cut into 2 inch squares.
Place about 1/2 teaspoon filling in the center of each.
Overlap two opposite corners of dough over filling and seal. Sprinkle lightly with sugar.
Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350° F 10-12 minutes or until corners are light brown. Cool on wire racks.
